newsitem.title: UK: NatWest raises base rate to 6.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: NatWest raises base rate to 6.0 percent.

text.p: National Westminster Bank said on Wednesday it has raised its base lending rate by one quarter point to six percent following a similar increase from the Bank of England.
NatWest joined Barclays in following the Bank of England (BoE).

UK Chancellor Kenneth Clarke said he was determined to keep a firm grip on inflation while the BoE said the move was designed to moderate the pace of the upswing and would reduce the need of tightening in the future.
